title: Mixed Event — A Bright Future!! — Episode4 Unexpected Advice

meta.Event Outline: Bit by bit, the members of Leo/need continue preparations for their first show together. Their new song is coming along well, and all that's left is for Ichika to add her lyrics. She's determined to express the feelings that Saki put into the composition, but will it be so easy...?

rows.Line: The next day
Live House

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I see.
How to write lyrics, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes. I was hoping that you'd know something since you've seen so many bands come through here.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: I understand. However, Hinomori, just as you say, each band has their own style, so there really is no such thing as a right answer.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: My impression is that you should let your friend work through her process until she finds something that rings true with her.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: To be fair, I've never done anything like that before, so I'm probably not the best person to ask.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I guess there really isn't much we can do for her...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hi, about our next show...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, Hinomori?
I didn't know you were working today.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And this is...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, this is Mochizuki, the drummer for Leo/need. It's been a little while.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Nice to meet you, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
But did something happen?
You all seem really concerned.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's nothing that serious.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Wait, Hinomori, why don't you ask Iori for some advice...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: She's the lyricist for STANDOUT, so this might be an incredible opportunity for you and your band.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sorry, hang on. What's this about exactly?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I-If you'll let me...!
We're actually in the middle of composing our own song, but our friend is having some trouble writing lyrics for it...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've been trying to find ways to help her by listening to songs by other bands and such, but we haven't been able to find a good solution...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Writing lyrics for a song, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And...!
Would you mind if we asked you for some advice regarding this...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There must be something that we're just not seeing, so we're wondering if you could help us, Ms. Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd love to help but...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I don't know what's on your friend's mind or what she's going through, so nothing I say will probably end up helping.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Because in the end, she's the one who has to work it out and put pen to paper. Doing something some stranger says doesn't sound like a great solution.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I suppose you're right...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But she must be such a strong girl.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I mean, writing lyrics is all about taking a hard look at yourself, right?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Having a few clever-sounding words strung together doesn't mean it's gonna turn into a good song.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But based on what you've told me, that's not who your friend is. I can tell that she's really digging deep and trying to find those perfect words.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I love it when someone really commits to their music like that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Iori...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: I think the best thing you can do right now as her bandmates is to not shy away from whatever she writes or comes up with.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We kept thinking about what we could do for her all this time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But this really may be the best time for us to just put our faith in Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Like we did with Saki...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
So this Ichika is your lyricist?
Is she your front too?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Now I see. Is she still working on those lyrics you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
In all likelihood...
But there is a chance she's doing a street performance right now.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
A street performance?
That's pretty cool of her.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, she started doing them as a way to practice singing. Now, she's sort of a regular out there.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Wow, really...?
She must have a great work ethic.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Thanks for letting me know.
I'm wishing you and your song the best.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you very much...!
We really appreciate your help!
